title: MacroPulse Alert
message:
FOMC mins (Jul 28-29): 9-3 vote to hold — most hawkish split in years. Many participants flagged hikes if inflation doesn't cool. S&P 500 -0.6% post-release. Sept hike odds ~31%.
UK CPI (Jul): 2.9% YoY vs 2.6% prior, core 2.6% (est 2.5%) — four-month high. BOE cut path narrows.
BTC $64.4K (+1.3% 24h), ETH $1,920 (+0.4%) — both below alert thresholds, holding range.
